verdict.rationale: This story asks whether CockroachDB can act as an MCP *client*, consuming external MCP servers' tools. CockroachDB is a database, not an agentic/AI-assistant product; the evidence instead shows CockroachDB exposing its own MCP *server* for AI tools to connect to it (docs-4, docs-28, probe-4) — the opposite direction. There is no indication CockroachDB itself invokes or consumes other MCP servers' tools, so this client-side axis is a category mismatch for a database product.
